subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Vanquish
solution: The correct answer is **'Surrender.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Vanquish** means to defeat thoroughly, especially in a competition or conflict. (विशेषकर प्रतियोगिता या संघर्ष में पूरी तरह से हराना।) • **Example Sentence**: The home team vanquished all their opponents in the tournament. • **Surrender** in this case would mean to give up or capitulate, the opposite of vanquish. (हार मानना या आत्मसमर्पण करना।) • **Example Sentence: **After hours of fighting, the soldier had no choice but to surrender. **Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Halt:** Bring or come to an abrupt stop. (अचानक रोकना।) • **Finish:** Bring (a task or activity) to an end; complete. (किसी कार्य को समाप्त करना; पूरा करना।) • **Stoop:** Bend one's head or body forward and downward. (सिर या शरीर को आगे और नीचे झुकाना।) 35:T9df, The correct answer is** 'Option 1' i.e. 'Greedy'**
